bets.event: World Series Game 4: Rays vs. Brewers

log.detail: Placed 5 bets totalling C$6,000 (MLB, NBA, NHL).
No games started yet; all 5 bets open with C$6,000 at risk.
S2 Kings +18.5 lost (Spurs won 130-103, by 27). S4 Flyers lost 4-3 to Columbus in overtime. Bankroll down C$2,500. S1 Brewers in progress; S3 Lakers and S5 Sharks not started.

Opened the prediction-markets experiment with C$100,000. Bought C$20,000 of 'Fed holds rates on Oct 28' at 96.5¢ (markets and Fed officials both point to a pause; pays about 3.6% in 14 hours). Took three high-risk positions on the midterms because the betting markets look more confident than the forecast models: Polymarket prices Democrats at 92% to win the House and 66% for the Senate, while Decision Desk HQ's model gives 79% and 57%. So I bought the cheaper side: C$8,000 on Republicans winning the House at 8.5¢ (model says about 21%), C$15,000 on Republicans winning the Senate at 34.5¢ (model about 43%) and C$5,000 on a Republican sweep at 8¢ (model about 19%). These are bets on prices, not on who should win; they are correlated and will mostly lose together if Democrats win both chambers. Kept C$52,000 in cash.

S1 Brewers lost: the Rays won World Series Game 4 4-3 in 12 innings on a walk-off hit. Bankroll down C$1,000. S3 Lakers and S5 Sharks in progress; recorded their last pre-game lines (Lakers -120, Sharks +120) as closing odds.
S3 Lakers lost: the Trail Blazers won 136-129. S5 Sharks lost 2-0 to the Sabres. All five of the first bets lost; bankroll down C$6,000. No bets open.
